title: Java Software Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.


With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.


Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

You will be part of an international team, driving the development of 1GLOBAL's eSIM platform, including our consumer and IoT solutions. We are looking for a talented developer and team player, capable of handling architectural and technical specifications, designing and implementing new services, maintaining existing components, and testing our applications.
The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build high impact features and contribute to the architecture design; aim towards resiliency, scalability, security and fault tolerance;
  • Advocate for high code quality, readability and high tests coverage;
  • Promote best practices for a high-scale web (or mobile) environment;
  • Work with an Agile methodology;
  • Identify areas of improvement in the codebase and promote them through seamless integrations, documenting solutions and new flows;
  • Mentor junior members when needed and contribute with meaningful reviews.
  • 4+ years of experience in Java software development;
  • Experience with unit/integration/e2e testing (test-driven development is a plus);
  • Proficiency with REST APIs, both in implementing and consuming the interfaces;
  • Experience with development tools and processes (Git-flow, peer reviewing);
  • Familiarity with relational databases, CI/CD flows, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes;
  • Good understanding of cloud services and scalable infrastructure;
  • Excellent communication skills (fluent in English, both written and spoken), with a self-motivated and autonomous mindset.

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 40% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

El salario base dependerá de factores como ubicación, experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Además, ofrecemos beneficios adicionales, incluyendo bonificaciones anuales e incentivos por ventas o uso. Nuestra política de compensación busca garantizar justicia y equidad a nivel global.

Job description

Sobre a Rodobens:

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Por que a Rodobens?

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade.

Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação

Consórcio

A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA: foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais.

Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor.

Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra: confiabilidade!

Main responsibilities

No dia a dia você irá:

  • Realizar atendimento e negociação com nossos clientes, no local para comercialização de consórcio;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais para clientes;
  • Prospectar novos negócios, visando manter as carteiras de cliente atualizadas;
  • Realizar a prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Realizar cadastro de clientes e garantir a atualização da informação legal do cadastro;
  • Acompanhar o fluxo financeiro do ciclo de crédito;
  • Visitar novos clientes com os consultores dos distribuidores;

Requirements and skills

Para participar do nosso processo você precisa ter:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino Superior Cursando/Completo;
  • Habilidades: proativo; responsável; habilidade para resolver problemas, matemática básica (demonstrações financeiras / cálculos simples);

O que é o nosso time de DITI – Departamento de Infraestrutura de TI?
O departamento tem como missão planejar e gerenciar infraestrutura necessária para o funcionamento de toda a cadeia de processos de backup e restore dos ambientes, auxiliando na garantia da disponibilidade e continuidade dos negócios da organização.

Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido

Como será seu dia a dia?

Sendo Product Engineering, atuará na gerência de Infraestrutura e suas principais atividades serão:

  1. Desenvolver e implementar soluções automatizadas para otimizar a gestão e operação de clusters Kubernetes;
  2. Garantir a escalabilidade e a eficiência das soluções automatizadas;

  7. Projetar e desenvolver arquiteturas robustas e escaláveis para o produto;

  10. Garantir a qualidade do código através de revisões e testes rigorosos.

Requisitos e Qualificações

O que você precisa ter ou saber?

  1. Conhecimento dos produtos Red Hat OpenShift e Azure Kubernetes Service AKS;
  2. Expertise em ambientes Kubernetes - Instalação, configuração, otimização e resolução de problemas. Profundo conhecimento da infraestrutura interna do Kubernetes e seus Addons - API Server, Scheduler, ETCD, Kubelet, Métricas, Logging, DNS;
  3. Experiência em gestão de registry de imagens e de todo o ecosistema de build e deploy - Políticas de push e pull, otimização, ciclo de vida;
  4. Expertise em Segurança de plataformas Kubernetes - Updates de versão, Hardening, RBAC, Network Policies, Vulnerabilidades, Postura;
  5. Experiência com soluções de monitoramento e observabilidade como Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch;
  6. Profundo entendimento de conceitos de redes, incluindo topologias, balanceamento de carga. Compreensão das redes no contexto do Kubernetes, incluindo serviços, Ingress, Network Policies e CNI (Container Network Interface);
  7. Compreensão dos tipos de soluções de armazenamento e gerenciamento no contexto Kubernetes, como NFS, Object Storage, Persistent Volumes;
  8. Experiência com cloud Azure - Compute, Network, Storage, Security, Architecture;
  9. Fluência em Sistema Operacional Linux Red Hat - Comandos e operação;
  10. Necessário experiência em Ansible, Terraform, Bash. Outras ferramentas ou linguagens serão um diferencial.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  1. Certificações Azure e Kubernetes.

description:
Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Go (Golang) Software Engineer for Identity Management to work on authorization and access management across Canonical's suite of enterprise products and web services, using Go (Golang) and Python.
As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products.
Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.
The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and optionally Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You are a software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform
In addition:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

O Programa tem como objetivo apoiar pessoas com deficiência intelectual e sua família em sua inserção na sociedade e na busca por autonomia. O serviço se dá por meio de visitas domiciliares e do acompanhamento e da supervisão em atividades cotidianas, como idas ao mercado e passeios em parques, praças e outros locais de convivência. Os profissionais acompanham e orientam os usuários até que eles desenvolvam a capacidade de realizar tais atividades sozinhos.

As equipes do APD ficam nos Centros Especializados em Reabilitação (CERs) e são compostas de Enfermeiro, Psicólogo, Terapeuta Ocupacional e Acompanhantes da Pessoa com Deficiência.

Responder técnico administrativamente pelo Programa;

Compor a equipe, participando das intervenções necessárias ao cumprimento dos objetivos do Programa e da rotina de trabalho;

Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes, metodologia e metas do Programa na área de sua responsabilidade;

Acompanhar o desenvolvimento do Programa na sua área de abrangência;

Promover, junto com a equipe, o estabelecimento de parcerias, visando ampliar a rede de serviços e suporte social às pessoas com deficiência;

Estimular, e propiciar a participação das Pessoas com Deficiência, cuidadores e familiares, no planejamento e avaliação das ações do Programa;

Participar de reuniões técnicas da Unidade de Saúde;

Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;

Organizar reuniões periódicas com a equipe do Programa para definição e avaliação das estratégias de atuação e formação técnica;

Realizar levantamentos de dados, controles administrativos, acompanhar indicadores quantitativos e qualitativos do Programa;

title: Sr Product Manager - Regionalization, Delivery Experience
description:
Sr Product Manager - Regionalization, Delivery Experience

At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. We act intentionally to ensure our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve.
In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed to sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. We recognize our responsibility and need for change, understanding that ‘Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility’. Our affinity groups are built from volunteers from different businesses and actively participate in defining our DE&I strategies. They act as ambassadors of this agenda and will support you from Day1. Remember, at Amazon ‘It’s always Day1’. Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities.
For millions of customers worldwide, the Amazon name is synonymous with delivery – and the Delivery Experience (DEX) team provides those customers with innovative ways to get what they want and need, enabling the choices they make on every order, every day. We combine customer impact with retail invention, solving huge technical challenges along the way.

Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon.com.br is an important and fast-growing business for Amazon.

We are looking for a Sr. Product Manager to lead Delivery Experience Regionalization. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining high-impact processes and supporting teams that help us deliver on our customer promise seamlessly. This role will partner closely with Amazon Transportation, Operations, Finance, Retail, and WW DEX leadership to solve customer-facing shipping solutions.

Key job responsibilities:

  1. Define and deliver important programs with broad cross-functional and cross-organizational business impact.
  2. Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of a highly complicated cross-functional project in a new business area.
  3. Delivery strategy: work closely with team leadership to define priorities for delivery strategy internally and with partners, using data to create and communicate business plans to senior leadership.
  4. Product Definition: incorporate benchmarking information from local competitors as well as best practices and lessons learned from other geographies to define best-in-class customer experience.
  5. Support and own the design and development of projects, working through all related dependencies with internal and external teams, mainly Operations, Transportation, Buyer Risk Prevention, and Technology teams.
  6. Develop customer requirements (user stories, use cases) and business requirements, participating in the design of the user experience, release goals, and prioritization of assigned features according to customer value.
  7. Bring strong, data-driven business and strategic judgment to decisions.
  8. Develop business and process requirements, prioritize needs, and manage milestones and overall roadmap.
  9. Enhance Amazon delivery experience, including the definition of shipping prices and shipping promotions.
  10. Bring analytical horsepower, enhanced Excel skills (and ideally SQL), and a deep curiosity about how things work.
  11. Identify and develop opportunities for improved cash flow in Shipping Programs.
  12. Engage with senior leadership on drafting proposals for new concepts, improvement plans, 3-year strategy, and outlook.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Relevant years of product or program management, product marketing, business development, or technology experience.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition.
- Experience with end-to-end product delivery.
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product.
- Experience as a product manager or owner.
- Experience owning technology products.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data-driven insights.
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders.

A Congregação das Irmãs de Santa Marcelina foi fundada pelo Beato Luigi Biraghi em 1838, na Itália, motivado pelos valores éticos, humanitários e cristãos, por meio do amor e do exemplo educador. Fazemos parte da LM Soluções de Mobilidade e atuamos há mais de 40 anos no mercado, oferecendo aos nossos clientes produtos e serviços totalmente personalizados, seja em terceirização de frotas, assinatura de veículos e de caminhões, venda de seminovos e aluguel para motoristas de aplicativo.

O nosso maior patrimônio é construído por meio das pessoas que fazem a diferença todos os dias em nosso time. Temos como propósito estimular o poder de transformação em nossas pessoas e clientes, prezando pelo desenvolvimento de relações verdadeiras e humanizadas.

Somos guiados pela ética, compromisso e transparência ao conduzir nossos negócios. Fazer parte do nosso time é ser protagonista da sua carreira e desenvolver ações que transformem ainda mais a nossa história.

Main responsibilities

O Analista de Compras de Indiretos será responsável por apoiar o processo de aquisição de bens e serviços necessários para o bom funcionamento da operação da empresa. O profissional atuará em colaboração com diversas áreas da organização, visando garantir o atendimento de necessidades internas com qualidade, dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e de acordo com os critérios de custos estabelecidos pela empresa.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Gestão de Compras: Realizar o processo de compras de materiais e serviços, como equipamentos de escritório, serviços de manutenção, limpeza, segurança, entre outros.
  • Negociação com Fornecedores: Negociar preços, prazos e condições com fornecedores, buscando sempre as melhores opções que atendam às necessidades da empresa e estejam dentro do orçamento.
  • Análise de Orçamentos e Propostas: Analisar cotações e propostas recebidas de fornecedores, avaliando custo-benefício e realizando comparações para garantir a escolha mais vantajosa para a empresa.
  • Apoio Administrativo: Emissão de pedidos de compras, lançamento de informações no sistema de gestão e acompanhamento do status dos pedidos.
  • Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Manter uma comunicação eficaz e constante com os fornecedores, acompanhando o cumprimento de prazos de entrega e qualidade dos materiais e serviços fornecidos.
  • Acompanhamento de KPIs: Auxiliar no acompanhamento de indicadores de desempenho da área de compras, como tempo de entrega, redução de custos e conformidade com orçamentos.
  • Compliance e Procedimentos Internos: Garantir que todas as compras sejam realizadas em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos internos da empresa, incluindo a realização de processos de licitação, quando necessário.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa ou cursando em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência anterior na área de compras (experiência em compras de produtos e serviços será um diferencial).
  • Conhecimento básico em processos de compras e negociação com fornecedores.
  • Habilidade em utilizar sistemas de gestão de compras e ERP.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), especialmente Excel para elaboração de relatórios e análise de dados.
  • Boa comunicação, negociação e organização.
  • Capacidade analítica e foco em resultados.

Desejáveis:

  • Noções de contratos e termos comerciais.
  • Familiaridade com o mercado de aluguel de frotas e necessidades específicas desse setor.

Responsabilidades:

O Especialista em Programação é responsável por garantir a execução pontual das atividades de produção no chão de fábrica, criando, monitorando e ajustando o cronograma de produção de acordo com a demanda e as restrições de capacidade.

  1. Criar cronogramas de produção detalhados que alinhem demanda, disponibilidade de recursos e capacidades de produção.
  2. Avaliar a capacidade e a carga de trabalho semanalmente, implementando medidas para prevenir sobrecarga.
  3. Eliminar a sobrecarga na fábrica distribuindo a carga de maneira equilibrada entre os centros de trabalho com capacidade semelhante e estabelecer um plano de terceirização sempre que necessário.

  5. Responder prontamente a mudanças na demanda ou interrupções na produção, ajustando o cronograma conforme necessário.
  6. Monitorar o progresso da produção, garantindo que as datas de início/solicitação da Ordem de Trabalho (WO) sejam alcançadas conforme planejado.
  7. Garantir que as WOs com operações de processo externo sejam enviadas pontualmente aos fornecedores.
  8. Otimizar as sequências de produção para minimizar os prazos de entrega e maximizar a utilização dos recursos.
  9. Colaborar com o planejador para alinhar os cronogramas diários de produção com os planos de produção mensais e semanais.
  10. Trabalhar com a equipe de armazém para garantir que os materiais necessários sejam retirados e preparados para as WOs programadas.
  11. Avaliar os potenciais riscos do cronograma e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação por meio de terceirização.
  12. Fornecer atualizações regulares à gestão sobre o cumprimento do cronograma, destacando quaisquer desvios e as ações corretivas tomadas.
  13. Monitorar os níveis de estoque de peças de reposição e garantir a disponibilidade dos materiais e equipamentos necessários, se aplicável.
  14. Analisar procedimentos e identificar áreas para melhoria em eficiência e custo-benefício.
  15. Coordenar informações com outros membros da equipe funcional, incluindo, mas não se limitando a, cotações, gestão de pedidos, engenharia, contabilidade, planejamento e recursos humanos.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  1. Graduação Completa em Administração, Engenharia, Contabilidade, ou área relacionada.
  2. Experiência prévia na função de programação, idealmente na indústria de petróleo e gás.
  3. Proficiência no uso de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de programação.

title: Senior RPA Developer
description:
About Nubank

Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world.

Today, Nubank is a global company, with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Buenos Aires (Argentina), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in São Paulo, by Colombian David Vélez, and co founded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit .

About the team

The Talent Acquisition Operations (TA Ops) team enables Nubank’s Talent Acquisition function to scale with consistency, speed, and quality. We operate and evolve the core systems and processes that support hiring while designing solutions that support recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates throughout their journeys. With a strong focus on automation, data quality, and user experience, we work to reduce manual effort and enhance decision-making across the board.

In this role, you’ll also be embedded in Nubank’s Business Automation hub – a central team focused on helping functions across the company become more efficient and scalable. There, you’ll collaborate with technical peers to align on architecture, implementation, and standards, ensuring consistency in what we deliver and supporting your ongoing technical development.

You will be responsible for
  • Process Analysis and Optimization: Collaborate closely with stakeholders within Talent Acquisition to thoroughly analyze existing business processes. Identify and prioritize opportunities for automation, focusing on areas that can benefit from increased efficiency, accuracy, and cost reduction.
  • Automation Development and Implementation: Leverage your expertise in UiPath and AI technologies to design, develop, and implement robust and scalable automation solutions. This includes building workflows, configuring bots, and integrating AI capabilities like machine learning and natural language processing to handle complex tasks.
  • Systems Integration: Work with multiple Talent Acquisition systems and tools, including Greenhouse (ATS), GEM (CRM), GoodTime (interview scheduling), custom-built solutions, and broader HR platforms. Design and maintain seamless data flows between systems, ensuring integration supports efficient processes while upholding data integrity and security across all automation workflows.
  • Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Act as a mentor and guide to less experienced team members. Share your knowledge and expertise, provide guidance on best practices, and foster a collaborative learning environment within the team.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Actively participate in multidisciplinary teams, working closely with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to deliver comprehensive automation solutions that align with business goals and objectives.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Management: Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of developed solutions. This includes creating flow diagrams, technical manuals, user guides, and other relevant documentation to ensure knowledge transfer and ease of maintenance.
  • Innovation and Technology Trend Analysis: Stay abreast of emerging technologies and trends in automation. Proactively identify and evaluate new tools, techniques, and methodologies that can be leveraged to enhance existing automation or develop innovative solutions.
We are looking for a person who

Must-Have:

  • At least 4 years of experience in business process automation using RPA.
  • Proficiency in the UiPath tool, including development in Studio, StudioX, and automation with Orchestrator.
  • Experience with databases, especially with SQL Server, for queries, data extraction, and integration with automation.
  • Experience in creating and optimizing AI prompts using language models like GPT (or similar tools).
  • Solid knowledge of development best practices, such as code versioning, testing, and design patterns applied to automation.
  • Ability to analyze, document, and optimize processes before automation.
  • Experience with RESTful API integrations and automation involving web services.
  • Proactivity and team collaboration skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, translating technical terms into accessible language.
  • Focus on practical solutions and problem-solving.
  • Advanced English

Nice to Have:

title: CX Branding Senior Specialist
description:
Why GMF?

GM Financial International Operations conducts business in Latin America and China. International Operations offers a wide range of wholesale and retail automotive financing products to dealers and their customers. The strength of the international business lies in its ability to tailor its products to meet unique dealer needs, consumer preferences and national requirements in local markets. Latin American country operations include Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru.

About the role

The Brand Senior Specialist (3F) is responsible for enhancing the brand experience for both internal and external audiences. This involves delivering superior consumer content, maintaining brand identity, and ensuring alignment with GM Financial brands. The specialist optimizes resources, manages budgets, participates in key projects, and collaborates with stakeholders from General Motors and GM Financial globally.

Also, drives a customer-centric approach by developing content for key initiatives and executing high-end internal marketing. A crucial part of their role is integrating the Think Customer mind-set into daily operations through continuous engagement and promoting employee empowerment.

The Senior Specialist must set high standards of performance, maintain effectiveness during major changes, have ability to prioritize work, establish plans of execution, and implement an organized work methodology to ensure proper traceability of tasks. Passion for creating positive impacts for customers is essential.

What you need

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Advertising, etc.
  • Performance Standards: Demonstrated ability to set and maintain performance standards across projects, aligning efforts with organizational goals.
  • Project Management: Strong track record in project management, including developing and executing plans that prioritize tasks for timely project completion.
  • Team Leadership: Experience leading multifunctional and/or multicultural teams or individuals without formal authority.
  • Agile Design: Comfort with designing within an agile design lifecycle.
  • Marketing Expertise: Proven experience in marketing, brand implementation, and content creation, with a solid understanding of best practices in internal marketing strategies.
  • Creative Agency Management: Proven experience in managing relationships with creative agencies, overseeing the execution of projects, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines, and optimizing the use of allocated budgets.
  • Global Collaboration: Demonstrated global experience, with the ability to effectively collaborate with teams in different countries and navigate cultural nuances.
  • Visual Aesthetics Expertise: Exceptional eye for design and visual aesthetics, with the ability to create visually compelling content that aligns with brand guidelines and enhances audience engagement.
  • Attention to Detail: Detail-oriented with an expert eye for design and visual aesthetics, ensuring all content aligns with brand guidelines and resonates with the target audience.
  • Content Creation: Proficiency in content creation, including the development of content pillars and copywriting, with the ability to craft compelling narratives that engage and inspire audiences.

What you will be doing

  • Brand Governance: Implement the Global Brand Governance accurately across all markets, ensuring alignment with parent brands and involving key stakeholders from General Motors and GM Financial.
  • Brand Identity Management: Manage and maintain the brand identity, including the development and enforcement of brand guidelines and assets.
  • Content Creation: Develop and execute content that aligns with the brand identity and resonates with the target audience.
  • Content Oversight: Oversee the creation of high-quality, engaging content across multiple platforms in all markets, ensuring consistency and relevance.
  • Agency and Budget Management: Manage relationships with creative and content agencies, ensuring optimal use of the allocated budget.
  • Asset Management: Develop and maintain up-to-date brand experience assets.
  • Action Plan Execution: Ensure the successful execution of defined action plans, monitoring progress, coordinating with relevant teams and stakeholders, and ensuring tasks are completed on time and within budget.
  • Stakeholder Guidance: Provide guidance and support to stakeholders and vendors for the correct implementation of brand and content strategies.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with other functional/departmental managers to ensure full visibility of goals, purposes, and achievements, supporting business requirements.
  • Open Communication: Foster an open communication environment that encourages information sharing, values diverse viewpoints, and seeks input from others.
  • Project Management: Develop comprehensive execution plans for service design projects, setting clear activities, expected outcomes, timelines, and milestones to ensure project success.
  • Performance Standards: Establish clear performance standards for service initiatives, ensuring consistency and quality.
  • Internal Initiatives: Drive the strategic creation and implementation of internal initiatives assigned to the area, supporting the positioning of these initiatives.
  • Think Customer Integration: Integrate the Think Customer initiative into daily operations through continuous engagement, training, and promoting employee empowerment.
  • Strategy Monitoring: Monitor and report on the effectiveness of the implemented brand and content strategies, making necessary adjustments for continuous improvement.

What we offer

At GM Financial we want you to be the most authentic version of yourself. We take care of your work-life balance by programming wellness and integration activities, where you will strengthen your relationships with peers and contribute towards the development and wellbeing of your community, while providing you with a competitive salary and benefits. Some of our global benefits include Extended Maternity & Paternity Leaves, Personal Days & Community Investment hours.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
Career Opportunities: Internal Auditor (17611)

World leader on its markets, Vallourec provides benchmark tubular solutions for the energy sector and other highly demanding applications: from oil and gas wells in extreme conditions to state-of-the-art power plants, including bold architectural projects and high-performance mechanical equipment.

In figures, Vallourec is a French industrial group listed on the SBF120 with 16,000 employees and a turnover of 5 billion euros. With a presence in 20 countries, the group operates on all continents.

Vallourec also encompasses 40 production units, 380 researchers and technicians, 4 research and testing centers, and over 45 million euros invested in R&D.

Finally, drawing on its experience in the Oil & Gas sector, Vallourec is preparing for the future by currently developing a comprehensive portfolio of products and solutions that meet the needs of energy transition: carbon capture, hydrogen storage, geothermal energy.

This context makes the environment particularly dynamic and international.

Main missions and activities:

  • Assess the application of procedures and processes by entities, corporate departments and Shared Services Centers throughout the Group.
  • Carry out audit missions (periodic audits or investigation).
  • Prepare recommendations for findings in a report dispatched to the Group managers.

Reporting to the Internal Audit Director, the internal auditor is in charge of:

Periodic audits

  • Preparing and carrying out periodic audits in line with Group methodology.
  • Leading the preparatory phase of the audit to ensure maximum efficiency and to obtain a global understanding of the organization's entity, key events and main areas of risks.

This involves:

  • Preparing audit notifications schedules and agendas.
  • Overseeing the operational phase of the audit: acting as the entity's point of contact.
  • Coordinating data collection (financial data, business review, risk analysis, audit reports,...).
  • Conducting interviews with key managers and all persons involved.
  • Defining audit scope and objectives.
  • Carrying out and supervising tests based on work standards and procedures.
  • Finalizing audit findings and prioritizing recommendations.
  • Monitoring the progress of action plans resulting from the audits carried out, with reference to the timetable established with the entities.
  • Promoting the sharing of best practices between Group entities.
  • Sending a report to the internal control director after the final meeting (report which will then be sent to the entity and to the Vallourec senior managers).

Investigations

The internal auditor could participate in fraud detection and resolution:

  • Prepare and carry out investigations if needed with the internal control director.
  • Propose a relevant methodology and work plan to address specific risks.
  • Coordinate with external support (if any).
  • Write ad hoc reports with recommendations (action plans).

In support of the Director of Internal Audit, the senior internal auditor will also be involved in:

  • Building the annual audit plan.
  • Improving audit methodology (review of work program and best practices).

Notes:

  • Many travels abroad, including long distances needed (USA, Brazil, China, Dubaï...).
  • Corporate position with diversified contacts throughout the Group, worldwide, at all levels (with senior management as well as in mills or with shared service centers).
  • Demonstrate ability to communicate and coordinate with all VLR departments involved. Particularly, ability to write reports mentioning recommendations and being objective.

Requirements:

Experience:

  • Previous experience of internal audit.
  • International experiences (at least as a long term trainee or as a student).

Skills: Autonomy, rigor, dynamic and “agile” mindset, communication skills.

description:
Security Automation Engineer with Python

Join to apply for the Security Automation Engineer with Python role at Intuition Machines .

Intuition Machines builds enterprise security products with an AI/ML focus. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.

As a Security Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in automating and optimizing core Security Operations Center (SOC) processes. You will work on enhancing bot detection, fraud mitigation, phishing investigations, and other security automation efforts—enabling our security team to scale efficiently and precisely.

In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to uphold the highest standards of professionalism, secure coding practices, and clean code principles across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

  1. Develop automation tools and services: Design, build, and maintain automation tools that support SOC operations, managing the full lifecycle from initial requirements to implementation, deployment, and training.
  2. Leverage modern technologies: Utilize technologies such as microservices, Kubernetes, Python, and message queues to streamline workflows and enhance SOC capabilities.
  3. Collaborate with security analysts: Work closely with security experts to solve complex automation, security, and engineering challenges, continuously improving our tools and services.
  4. Research and implement new standards: Stay updated on emerging trends in security and automation, identifying new technologies and standards to enhance security products and processes.

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software development
  • Proficiency in Python

  • Experience writing secure code, with knowledge of OWASP security principles
  • Solid experience working with SQL databases
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Familiarity with developing microservices using Docker

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration
  • Familiarity with frontend technologies
  • Previous involvement in bug bounty programs or a track record of public CVEs and contributions to web application security research
  • Exposure to modern web browser security, web architecture, network protocols, and web automation frameworks
  • Working knowledge of Linux

What we offer:

  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours
  • An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world
  • Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often
  • High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting-edge R&D
  • Flat organization with direct interaction with customer teams

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all members of our team. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online!

Domaine Finance

Type de contrat CDI

Expérience Minimum 10 ans

Responsibilities:

  1. TEP BR was selected for Large Taxpayers Group under “Special Tax & Economic Monitoring”.
  2. Manage a fiscal environment that is heavy, complicated, and unstable (Expectation for a Brazilian Tax Reform on Income Taxes, Pillar 2, New Transfer Pricing Rules, Implementation of the Tax Reform on Consumption Taxes).
  3. Update ERP (new version of transactions and reports that are key for tax calculation and tax compliance).
  4. TEPBR is Operator on both Exploration and Production assets.
  5. Ensure and develop a team composed of 2 direct reports (2 Tax Coordinators) + 10 indirect reports (tax assistants, being 4 TTE staff and 6 TAS).
  6. Perform 3 SOX controls.

Support the Tax Manager in the following activities:

  1. Define the criteria used to determine the CIT/PIS/COFINS/ICMS/ISS/SPT/Royalties payments.
  2. Perform studies in view of implementing tax optimizations.
  3. Define the criteria used to identify, monitor, and compensate the tax credits.
  4. Define how to properly respond to tax inspections and audits.
  5. Define the criteria used to fulfil the tax books, files and reports delivered to the Tax Administration (Federal, State and Municipal sphere), in accordance with Brazilian legislations.
  6. Establish procedures and internal controls for tax routines and ensure that they are in accordance with SOX, audits, antifraud and anti-corruption guidelines.
  7. Provide support to Finance departments (Accounting; Treasury; B&P; etc) of TTE BR on tax matters.
  8. Ensure that the Transfer Pricing demonstration meets the local tax requirements and defense files are kept in good order.
  9. Provide support on tax matters for Budget preparation and LTP exercise.
  10. Ensure the correctness of inventories for tax purposes.
  11. Stay updated with the tax legislation and jurisprudence and cascade the relevant information to all concerned Stakeholders.
  12. Assist Customs/Freight Forward activities to ensure compliance with the tax legislation.
  13. Support the SAP and Mastersaf implementation/alterations.
  14. Act as focal point for the implementation of the Tax Reform.

Accountabilities:

  1. Coordinate the team's activities to provide the correct information and reports within the deadlines to all stakeholders, notably Finance (Quarterly Closings, PDCs, and other financial events).
  2. Act as a Manager as Coach: Coordinate, supervise and mentor/coach tax coordinators, optimizing work allocation, creating a positive work environment, and contributing to staff performance through regular feedback.
  3. Ensure that the tax team is updated with changes in tax legislation and relevant jurisprudence.
  4. Ensure compliance with Company’s internal policies and procedures.
  5. Ensure that Tax payments are done correctly and on time, avoiding penalties and interests.
  6. Inform concerned stakeholders of the impacts caused by changes in tax legislation.
  7. Assist internal and external stakeholders in all matters regarding corporate taxes and indirect taxes.
  8. Assess opportunities to minimize the tax burden of the company.
  9. Liaise with the Litigation team to ensure that the report of tax risks is accurate and complete.

Qualifications:

  1. University degree in Accounting and Law.
  2. At least 10 years’ experience in Tax Department (prior experience in a Big-4 firm would be a differential).
  3. Strong experience in the Oil & Gas Business.
  4. Advanced English proficiency.
  5. Ability to work under pressure and with sharp deadlines.
  6. Managerial and business skills.
  7. High autonomy.

title: Carbon Markets Policy Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Carbon Markets Policy Specialist to join our Carbon Markets Policy & Guidance team. The team tracks organizations and governments seeking to shape private sector responses to climate change and the development of the carbon credit market on the path to net zero. This vacancy is for an experienced researcher to join our team and take the lead on carbon market policy research in Latin America.

About the role:

This role will take a leading role on the continued development of MSCI Carbon Markets policy analysis, with a particular focus on the Latin America region. The Carbon Markets Policy Specialist will also be involved in collating qualitative and quantitative data to track organizations, investors and governments seeking to shape corporate responses to climate change and the use of carbon credits.

Key to success in this role will be the ability to generate concise insights from disparate sources of information, covering emerging or fast-moving policy areas and complex standards, reports, and regulations.

The role will be based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities will include:

  1. Analysis of national and subnational climate and carbon market policy in a range of countries, including conducting interviews and preparing country profiles.
  2. Tracking developments in international policy and standards relating to climate change, net zero and the voluntary carbon market.
  3. Qualitative and quantitative research across the policy areas covered by the team.
  4. Thought leadership on carbon markets and climate policy, with a focus on Latin America.
  5. Supporting MSCI’s COP30 strategy and policy engagement in the region.
  6. Communicating insights internally and externally, delivered to clients through client meetings and conferences, plus monthly reporting, an online platform, webinars and other research projects.

Successful candidates will have research, advisory or public policy experience relating to climate policy, carbon markets, or corporate climate strategies. This may have been gained through experience with research firms, governments, consultancy, corporate or investor sustainability teams, project developers, think tanks, NGOs, or academia.

Candidates should have a strong team ethic, excellent written communications skills, and be capable of extracting insights and communicating them with clarity to senior-level audiences.

Qualifications and experience:

  1. Degree in Environmental Studies, Climate Change, Public Policy, or a related field. Post-graduate degree preferred.
  2. At least 5 years’ experience from the public, private, financial or NGO sectors relating to climate change, net zero, or carbon markets.
  3. Experience with national climate policy or international climate negotiations is particularly welcomed.
  4. Excellent communication skills in English and Portuguese. Communication skills in Spanish would be a distinct asset for this role.
  5. Proven responsibility for delivering reports, briefings, or other written outputs.
  6. Presentation skills to clearly articulate ideas and facilitate strong relations with a global team of carbon and climate research analysts, technology and operations teams.
  7. Knowledge across various climate policy issues, with the ability to extract insights and communicate complex issues to senior-level audiences.
  8. Demonstrable enthusiasm for addressing climate change in the corporate and financial sectors.

This role is for you if you are:

  1. Aware of what a corresponding adjustment is and actively interested in Article 6 debates.
  2. Inquisitive, analytical, and naturally inclined to ask, ‘But what does this mean?’, ‘So what?’ and ‘What happens next?’
  3. Comfortable both writing a 20-page report and summarizing a new policy development in a sentence.
  4. Collaborate generously with your teammates but effective at working independently.
  5. Are passionate and pragmatic about how the world can tackle the climate challenge.

What we offer you:

  1. Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
  2. Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
  3. A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
  4. A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
  5. Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our platform, LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
  6. Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
  7. We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our purpose – to power better investment decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI is a leading provider of critical decision support tools and services for the global investment community. With over 50 years of expertise in research, data, and technology, we power better investment decisions by enabling clients to understand and analyze key drivers of risk and return and confidently build more effective portfolios. We create industry-leading research-enhanced solutions that clients use to gain insight into and improve transparency across the investment process.

You will work with agile teams of engineers, product owners, and software developers to deliver high-quality, secure, and reliable solutions, enhancing the application development experience for customers, developers, and solution providers.

  8. Document and track bugs until resolution.

  10. Collaborate with QA colleagues, developers, and product owners to improve quality and testing strategies.

  • Debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to produce clear documentation (OpenAPI, Markdown).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with agile frameworks like Scrum/SAFe or Kanban.

title: Comprador direto e indireto
description:
O Comprador indireto será responsável por obter, negociar e comprar bens e serviços indiretos, incluindo material de escritório, equipamento de TI, serviços de manutenção e itens de instalações, uniformes, EPIs (equipamentos de proteção individual), ferramentas e outros itens consumíveis.
Essa função envolve trabalhar em estreita colaboração com vários departamentos para entender suas necessidades, gerenciar relacionamentos com fornecedores e garantir a conformidade com as políticas e orçamentos da empresa, além de garantir que o material/serviço seja entregue com base no pedido de compra, dando suporte a todos os departamentos.


PRINCIPAIS DEVERES

  1. Integrar o fornecedor, solicitar detalhes do fornecedor para configuração e enviá-los por meio do processo interno.
  2. Identificar e avaliar fornecedores para bens e serviços indiretos. Negociar contratos e preços para obter um bom valor para a organização.
  3. Solicitar cotação aos fornecedores, analisar os preços e termos de pagamento, garantindo o alinhamento com as condições pré-estabelecidas e validar ou enviar para um novo processo de aprovação com evidências apropriadas.
  4. Revisar as requisições com clareza e precisão, obter a cotação e prosseguir com as requisições para o pedido de compra indireto.
  5. Coordenar o fluxo de trabalho de aprovação do pedido de compra e garantir que todas as partes apropriadas envolvidas o aprovem antes de enviar o pedido de compra ao fornecedor.
  6. Enviar o pedido de compra aos fornecedores locais e internacionais com base nas requisições internas.
  7. Monitorar POs vencidos ou parcialmente recebidos para garantir que todos os itens sejam recebidos antes do pagamento.
  8. Gerenciamento de fornecedores, construir e manter relacionamentos com fornecedores para garantir entrega, serviço e conformidade com os acordos contratuais.
  9. Recebimento e validação de faturas com pedido de compra para encaminhá-lo à equipe de estoque e/ou equipe de logística.
  10. Liderar negociações com fornecedores sobre questões relacionadas a discrepâncias em quantidades, preços e outras condições.
  11. Manter o banco de dados organizado, atualizar a documentação e alcançar.
  12. Colaboração multifuncional, trabalhando com as partes interessadas internas para entender suas necessidades de aquisição e fornecer soluções oportunas.
  13. Fornecer atendimento ao cliente para as partes interessadas internas e externas para garantir assistência adequada na aquisição e entrega de bens e serviços necessários.
  14. Pesquisa de mercado, manter-se informado sobre tendências de mercado e estratégias de preços para tomar decisões de compra informadas.
  15. Gestão de orçamento, monitorar e gerenciar gastos contra restrições orçamentárias, garantindo eficácia nas decisões de compra.
  16. Identificar oportunidades de eficiência de processos e implementar as melhores práticas em aquisição.
  17. Monitoramento de KPI.
  18. Dar suporte a auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências, documentação e informações solicitadas, bem como fornecer quaisquer explicações necessárias.
  19. Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento, fornecendo suporte técnico aos pares.

Escopo direto

  1. Enviar a ordem de compra aos fornecedores locais e internacionais com base na demanda para evitar escassez e excesso.
  2. Gerenciar o processo da cadeia de suprimentos, incluindo a colocação do pedido, rastreamento e acompanhamento até o recebimento do material do depósito.
  3. Comunicar-se com o fornecedor sobre entrega antecipada, problemas de estoque e itens alternativos aprovados quando necessário.
  4. Sourcing e aquisição, identificar, avaliar e selecionar fornecedores para materiais diretos, garantindo o alinhamento com as necessidades de produção e os padrões da empresa.

description:
Join to apply for the Proposal Analyst role at SSE Brasil - Sirio Solutions Engineering

Join to apply for the Proposal Analyst role at SSE Brasil - Sirio Solutions Engineering

SSE is a multinational company with Italian roots and over 40 years of history, beginning operations in 1984 in the Prato region.

In 2009, we established our presence in Brazil, in the city of Santos, and have since become a trusted provider of engineering solutions and services focused on turbomachinery for the oil and gas sector.

Our services span across mechanical, control and automation, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines, through which we’ve successfully completed thousands of engineering and installation projects worldwide.

Our core business is delivering turnkey engineering solutions , offering tailored services and consulting with a single point of responsibility. We strive to reduce total operating and maintenance costs while enhancing the availability, efficiency, and operational reach of installed turbomachinery fleets, regardless of the original equipment manufacturer.

With this purpose in mind, we install and commission integrated solutions for rotating equipment, auxiliary systems, and process plants—executing both greenfield projects and brownfield upgrades to optimize and modernize mature production assets.

We also provide training, maintenance, after-sales support, remote monitoring, and other value-added services, leveraging cutting-edge digital technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare commercial, technical, and budgetary proposals, considering pricing, feasibility, risk, and cost structure.
  • Monitor and ensure deadlines are met throughout the proposal cycle, from initiation to delivery to the client.
  • Create and manage documentation and reports related to proposals, including technical, commercial, and financial information.
  • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, production, and logistics teams to gather cost estimates, lead times, and required resources.
  • Consolidate cost estimates and define pricing strategies based on established margins and business goals.
  • Participate in internal meetings and occasionally client meetings to align proposal scope and conditions.
  • Support the sales team during contract negotiations when needed.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Control and Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in technical and/or commercial proposals, preferably in control and automation or oil & gas engineering companies.
  • Strong knowledge of cost analysis, pricing, and bid documentation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Experience with platforms such as Petronect, Ariba, or similar tools.

Soft Skills

  • Organization and attention to detail – Essential for managing technical documents, bids, and tight deadlines with accuracy and quality.
  • Analytical thinking – Ability to interpret technical and commercial requirements, assess proposal feasibility, and identify potential risks.
  • Proactivity – Anticipates needs, seeks information from involved departments, and acts independently to ensure timely delivery.
  • Effective communication (written and verbal) – Clarity in drafting proposals, interacting with technical and commercial teams, and presenting information objectively.
  • Teamwork – Works collaboratively with engineering, procurement, finance, and sales in a respectful and integrated manner.
  • Time and priority management – Handles multiple demands simultaneously while meeting schedules and delivery timelines.
  • Resilience and adaptability – Adjusts quickly to changes in scope, deadlines, or client requirements.
  • Results-oriented mindset – Committed to delivering high-quality, competitive, and accurate proposals.

description:
About Team

Uber for Business is a fast-growing Uber B2B solution serving a wide range of industries. We tackle large problems to adapt and best serve the needs of our customers and communities. Joining our team means making a significant impact by partnering with organizations to fully integrate their mobility, meals, and delivery solutions through Uber's simple and fast technologies. We #BuildWithHeart and #SeeTheForestAndTheTrees by focusing on the big picture while keeping the customer at the center of everything we do.

We are seeking a hands-on B2B marketing leader who thrives with autonomy and accountability, possesses a strong data-driven mindset, and can translate insights into actionable strategies. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator with outstanding leadership and project management skills, capable of navigating a fast-paced, dynamic environment while managing multiple stakeholders to drive strategic growth.

About The Role

As Marketing Lead for Brazil, you will own the end-to-end marketing strategy and execution for Uber for Business's enterprise offerings. Your target audiences include C-level executives at Fortune 500 companies and SMBs, with the goal of driving brand awareness and demand generation across multiple channels such as OOH, radio, digital performance, CRM, and in-app messaging. Reporting to the Regional Head of Marketing Latam, you will lead all country B2B marketing initiatives, manage cross-functional teams, and collaborate globally to scale our business in high-growth markets.

What The Candidate Will Do

  • Strategic Leadership & Accountability: Define and own marketing ROI and customer acquisition costs for Brazil, setting budgets, KPIs, and targets.
  • Develop plans: Create annual and quarterly strategies balancing brand building and performance marketing to meet revenue goals.
  • Integrated Campaigns: Launch national awareness campaigns (primarily digital) that generate measurable lift and consideration.
  • Creative Translation: Convert brand strategies into impactful creatives, overseeing visual and content approval for the region.
  • Performance Optimization: Lead cross-functional initiatives to centralize performance operations, continuously testing and refining media mixes, attribution models, and automation tools.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Manage teams in Brazil, Mexico, and the US, ensuring alignment across Product, Operations, Legal, PR, Media, and Customer Experience.
  • AI Adoption: Act as the internal AI ambassador, driving AI adoption, coaching peers, and identifying strategic opportunities.
  • Enterprise Field Marketing & CRM: Develop strategies for field marketing and partner with Sales, Finance, and Strategy to ensure smooth launches and long-term client relationships with C-suite executives at Fortune 500 companies.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years in B2B marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team.
  • Proven demand generation success for sales growth.
  • Experience launching integrated awareness campaigns.
  • Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills across multiple countries.
  • Analytical skills with experience in performance metrics, funnel optimization, and AI tools.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in Marketing, Business, or related; MBA preferred.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in agency digital strategy or in-house performance teams.
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Marketing Platform, Salesforce, Asana, and AI marketing platforms.

If you thrive on balancing big-brand creativity with data-driven rigor, excel at stakeholder management across markets, and are passionate about harnessing AI to redefine enterprise marketing in Latin America, join us!

Additional Details

  • Seniority Level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment Type: Full-time
  • Job Function: Marketing and Sales
  • Industries: Internet, Marketplace Platforms

title: Desenvolvedor de Firmware
description:
Job description

A Kryptus é uma empresa brasileira com atuação global, especializada em cibersegurança e proteção de dados sensíveis . Com mais de 20 anos de história, somos referência no desenvolvimento de soluções avançadas em criptografia, segurança embarcada e defesa cibernética para os setores governamental, militar, financeiro e corporativo .

Quer ajudar o país a reduzir sua dependência tecnológica externa e, assim, subir mais um degrau rumo à soberania nacional? Que tal experimentar novos desafios técnicos em projetos com as Forças Armadas e grandes empresas parceiras do setor aeronáutico e de defesa?

Para atender essas demandas, estamos buscando Desenvolvedores de Firmware experientes para se juntarem ao nosso time.

Os profissionais atuarão de forma 100% presencial em projetos estratégicos de defesa, desenvolvendo, testando e integrando sistemas para uso em aeronaves e radares.

Main responsibilities

  1. Atuar na definição de arquitetura de sistemas embarcados;
  2. Desenvolver firmware bare-metal para equipamentos de defesa e aviônicos;
  3. Desenvolver e executar testes funcionais e de integração dos sistemas;
  4. Realizar estudos, leitura de normas e revisão de literatura técnica para implementação de sistemas auxiliares;
  5. Realizar análise e depuração de falhas, correção e otimização de código;
  6. Prestar suporte à certificação dos equipamentos;
  7. Redigir documentação técnica em inglês (análises, relatórios, manuais, resultados de testes etc.);
  8. Manter o código-fonte e demais artefatos do projeto sob controle de versão;
  9. Executar revisões de código e contribuir com a qualidade do software produzido.

Requirements and skills

OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Graduação em Ciências da Computação, Engenharia Eletrônica ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com microcontroladores das famílias MSP430 ou STM32;
  • Proficiência na linguagem C e em desenvolvimento de firmware bare-metal;
  • Ampla vivência na utilização de equipamentos de laboratório (analisador lógico, osciloscópio, multímetro, gerador de sinais etc.) e na exploração de documentação técnica (datasheets, manuais de referência, application notes etc.);
  • Inglês avançado para redação, leitura e comunicação oral;
  • Experiência com Git em linha de comando.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em técnicas e padrões de codificação segura (CERT C, MISRA etc.);
  • Experiência com linguagem Assembly;
  • Experiência com linguagens de descrição de hardware (VHDL, Verilog etc.) e com dispositivos de lógica programável (CPLD e FPGA);
  • Conhecimento em criptografia e implementação de algoritmos criptográficos em microcontroladores.

Additional information

A Kryptus oferece um pacote bem completo de benefícios:

  • Horário flexível
  • PLR
  • Cartão de benefício flexível que atende os seguintes pilares: (refeição, alimentação, mobilidade, saúde e educação)
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Vale transporte
  • TotalPass
  • Convênio SESC
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Licença maternidade/paternidade estendida
  • Plataforma de saúde mental (Terapia)

Além disso…

  • Fazemos happy hour constantes
  • Não usamos roupa social sem necessidade
  • Temos espaço de descontração
  • Oferecemos diversos tipos de comidas e bebidas, todos os dias, à vontade
  • Fazemos feedback periódico
  • Temos um ambiente colaborativo, com respeito à diversidade, de baixa burocracia e com constante incentivo à criatividade.

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

Com quem você trabalhará?

O time de Operações da Wabtec Diafrag responsável pela fabricação das peças produzidas na fábrica.

Como você irá fazer a diferença?

Como membro do time Operações, você será responsável por:

  1. Efetuar conferências

O que queremos saber sobre você?

  • Organização da rotina de trabalho
  • Relacionamento Interpessoal
  • Trabalhar em equipe

Como será o seu dia-a-dia?

Equipe aberta ao aprendizado e desenvolvimento, trabalho que permite desenvolvimento, com foco nas entregas e segurança de todos.

Who are we?

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status.
